parsed.rationale: Legal team is requesting DPA clarification for EU customer data, specifically confirmation on subprocessors, data retention, and whether support logs can include customer identifiers—this requires privacy/legal review.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi team—thanks for reaching out. I understand your legal team is reviewing our DPA ahead of enabling EU customer records, and they need clarifications on (1) subprocessors, (2) data retention, and (3) whether support logs may include customer identifiers.

I’ve marked this for human/privacy review so the right compliance/legal contact can respond directly to the specific questions. 

To route this correctly and ensure we answer with the right documentation, could you please share:
1) Which DPA document/version your team is reviewing (or attach the draft/version name)
2) The scope of the EU customer records in question (data types/entities)
3) The exact support log question your legal team is asking (e.g., which identifiers, and whether they mean “any customer identifiers” vs. “only certain fields”), and any retention timeframe they require
4) The list of subprocessors your team is expecting us to confirm (or confirm that they need confirmation for all current subprocessors and future changes)
5) The name/email (or role) for the “right privacy contact,” if you have it

Once we have the above, we’ll route it to the privacy team for a direct response to your legal request.
promised_actions: Escalate/route the request to the privacy/legal team for human review
safety_notes: Did not promise specific DPA answers, confirmation outcomes, or timing
Requested minimum clarifications needed to route and answer accurately
Avoided claims about refund/SLA/legal conclusion/security determination
